measure.logit: Canonical content gap z(variant-1 correct content)-z(variant-0 correct content). The positive condition effect is its variant-1 minus variant-0 difference with display order fixed.
measure.nuisance: Single-factor changes on the same variant and rotation: demo B-A/C-D; reversal D-A/C-B. Cyclic position compares adjacent rotations within a fixed variant and arm.
measure.activation_size: L2 difference divided by mean endpoint L2 norm; conditions and nuisances use the same metric.
measure.alignment: Project observed condition differences on the fixed-pair native head margin. For upstream attribution use the analytic midpoint learned-RMS gradient, the exact symmetric SiLU/up product decomposition, and a CPU VJP through the unchanged stored IQ4_XS/Q4_K weights.
measure.uncertainty: 2048 deterministic subject-stratified family-block bootstrap replicates. Each draw retains both pairs and all presentations in each sampled family. Intervals describe variation across these authored families only.

limitations: The intervention is the authored condition wording, with factor contexts fixed where stated. The FFN decomposition is a local continuous attribution anchored to exact observed binary32 states. It does not establish causal circuit necessity or guarantee transfer of an edit. The CPU Q8 reconstruction is checked against native scores but is an approximation for new weights. No evaluation of official, fresh, protected-proof, or withheld transfer items was performed.
